description: This file defines the ContentPage class, which handles rendering and generating web pages within a documentation site or similar project using the Todaymade Daux framework. It manages page attributes such as breadcrumbs, language, homepage status, and templates, integrating with project-specific classes and configurations.

classes.name: ContentPage
classes.description: Handles the rendering and page generation logic for documentation pages, including breadcrumb navigation, language detection, and template selection.

methods.name: isHomepage
methods.description: Determines if the current page is the homepage based on the file's position in the directory tree.

methods.name: isLanding
methods.description: Checks if the page is a landing page based on configuration and its homepage status.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets initial state variables such as whether the page is homepage and the page language.

methods.name: getBreadcrumbTrail
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb trail for navigation based on parent directories, supporting multilanguage.

methods.name: generatePage
methods.description: Main method that initializes page data and renders the page using the appropriate template.
